What Does The Name Retang Mean?
s: In Chinese transcription contexts, “Retang” sometimes represents pinyin “Rètáng” (热汤, “hot soup”) or “Rè Táng” as a disyllabic given name, though this is rare and usually a transliteration artifact; likewise, in French records “Retang” can be a phonetic or clerical variant of Rétang/Rétangue, possibly linked to étang (“pond”) in place-names.
